title: White Choc Cheesecake
description: A light, soufflé-like Japanese-inspired cheesecake made from white chocolate, cream cheese and eggs. Tastes like a giant marshmallow.

ingredients.text: 240g low-fat cream cheese, at room temperature

steps: Preheat the oven to 195°C/175°C fan. Line the sides and base of a 23cm round cake tin with baking paper.
Melt 240g of the white chocolate in the microwave in 20-second bursts. Add the cream cheese and stir. Blast for another 10 seconds if lumpy.
Separate the eggs. Add the yolks to the cheese and chocolate mixture and combine. Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks.
Slowly fold the egg whites into the chocolate mixture a spoonful at a time using a metal spoon.
Pour into the cake tin. Set in a baking tray and pour boiling water to a third of the way up to make a bain-marie.
Bake for 30 minutes, turn oven off, leave for 10 more minutes. Cool completely in the tin.
Melt remaining chocolate and drizzle over the top.
notes: Serves 8–10. Keeps for up to a week in the fridge.
